Listen to a PDF, transcribe a meeting, dictate a note, or send a research task to a browser agent. Models run on your device and keep working with no signal at all. On-Device AI puts chat, listening, transcription, notes, and research in one private app for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro. Your data stays on your device. Download a model once and the app keeps working on a plane, on the subway, or with no signal at all. Your chats, documents, recordings, and notes are processed and stored on your device. Online providers and web features are there when a task needs them, and only after you switch them on.
